original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can the production dyadic central-factor checker (scripts/experiments/complex_centers.py:verify_factor, exercised by scripts/audit_complex_centers.py / certificates/dyadic-central-factor.json) adopt the injective packed-row algorithm from research/central-factor-packed/ so the shipped verify-certificates path is faster while every coefficient check and receipt field stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling make verify-certificates poles. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared-point, mixed-point verify, ternary frames, parity-side, exclusion embedding residual, inplace compile-scan) were skipped. Ross Richardson's opt-in packed adapter already proved the algorithm; production still used the nested O(n^2) entrywise loop. This session wires that equivalent check into the shipped source and certificate pin.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: dyadic-central-factor is part of verify-certificates. A faster identical coefficient check does not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production verify_factor change with frozen baseline, identical factor and audit payloads, rejection/temp-corruption controls, certificate pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
evidence: PASS_CENTRAL_FACTOR_PRODUCTION via research/central-factor-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_CENTRAL_FACTOR_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; certificates/dyadic-central-factor.json differs from base only in the complex_centers.py source pin.
author: Wentao Li
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for orientation, overlap search, profiling, production wiring, packaging, benchmarking and writing. Not independent human peer review.
